  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The BAIT_SHA-pinned review-run filter assumes `.head_sha` is always present and a full SHA, so a null/empty/truncated value would cause the bait-triggered run to be missed silently.
  WHY: Reviewers disagreed on impact: some called it a false positive because GitHub normally returns full SHAs and the loop falls back to `no_review_triggered`, while others treated the silent miss as a medium-risk edge case.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1219-1243 | severity=medium | confidence=[1-5]

  PROBLEM: The timeout-path inventory dump makes an additional `gh_api_safe` API call after the polling loop has already run to timeout.
  WHY: Reviewers disagreed on impact: some considered it an intentional one-shot diagnostic with graceful fallback, while others noted it still consumes another API attempt on the failure path.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:893-903 | severity=low | confidence=[1-5]

  WHY: Reviewers agreed this is cosmetic only and that the `2>/dev/null || echo` fallback prevents the step from failing.
